title: azimuth_seurat
description:
Reference-based cell type annotation using Seurat's Azimuth (RunAzimuth()).
Unlike annotate/azimuth (which uses a single fixed pan-human neural network
with no reference choice), this component lets you pick which annotated
reference dataset to map the query onto: one of the curated Azimuth
references (e.g. "pbmcref", "bonemarrowref", "lungref"; see
https://azimuth.hubmapconsortium.org/references/ for the full, up to date
list), or a local directory containing a custom "ref.Rds" + "idx.annoy"
reference pair.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: The input (query) data to be annotated

assay.description:
Name of the Seurat assay to create from the input modality, and
to run the annotation on.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description:
Arguments controlling which Azimuth reference to map the query onto.
There is no training step: RunAzimuth() maps the query directly onto
the chosen reference's precomputed embeddings.

mapping arguments.title: Mapping arguments
mapping arguments.description: Lower-level arguments passed through to RunAzimuth().

umap_name.description: Name of the UMAP reduction added to the output, projected onto the reference's UMAP.

k_weight.description: Number of neighbors to consider when weighting anchors during label/embedding transfer.

n_trees.description: Number of trees used when building the annoy index for neighbor search.

mapping_score_k.description: Number of neighbors used to compute the per-cell mapping score.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
